content:
name: Stabilization materialization

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - foundation/stabilization

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: stabilization-materialization-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  materialize:
    if: github.actor != 'github-actions[bot]'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20

    steps:
      - name: Check out stabilization branch
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          ref: foundation/stabilization
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Populate empty artifact-system documents
        run: python3 scripts/populate-artifact-system.py

      - name: Regenerate machine-readable knowledge layer
        run: python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --write

      - name: Verify artifact-system population
        run: python3 scripts/populate-artifact-system.py --check

      - name: Verify machine-readable knowledge layer
        run: python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check

      - name: Commit deterministic derivatives and generated Draft baselines
        shell: bash
        run: |
          if git diff --quiet -- artifact-system machine; then
            echo "No materialization changes required."
            exit 0
          fi

          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add artifact-system machine
          git commit -m "docs(artifact-system): materialize draft corpus and machine layer"
          git push origin HEAD:foundation/stabilization
